title: SlicePlanner: Logic-Guided Agentic AI for Online QoS-Aware Network Slicing in Open RAN
abstract: arXiv:2611.33664v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptive network slicing in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) demands reconfiguration decisions that respond to live traffic conditions while remaining safe with respect to Service Level Agreement (SLA) constraints, a combination that purely data-driven controllers cannot reliably guarantee without continuous retraining. translated_title: SlicePlanner：面向开放无线接入网（O-RAN）在线服务质量感知网络切片的逻辑引导智能体AI
translated_abstract: 开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中的自适应网络切片要求重构决策既能响应实时流量状况，又能在服务级别协议（SLA）约束方面保持安全，而纯数据驱动的控制器若不进行持续再训练，则难以可靠地兼顾这两点。我们提出了SlicePlanner，这是一个逻辑引导的闭环框架，它将每次RAN重构视为一个受控假设：基于实时和历史关键性能指标（KPI）证据提出，经过显式SLA约束和挖掘得到的RAN控制规则过滤，且仅当动作后的测量结果证实了改进后才予以提交。SlicePlanner由两个协作的智能体组成：SliceSense负责监控实时KPI、检索上下文条件化证据，并通过代理引导的可准入性过滤器对候选RAN动作进行排序；SliceGuard则负责验证动作后的KPI响应、回滚有害的变更……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SlicePlanner提出了一种逻辑引导的闭环双智能体框架（SliceSense与SliceGuard），将每次O-RAN重构作为受控假设进行提出、SLA约束过滤与事后验证，从而在不依赖持续再训练的情况下实现安全可靠的在线QoS感知网络切片。
en_tdlr: SlicePlanner is a logic-guided closed-loop agentic AI framework that treats each RAN reconfiguration as a controlled hypothesis—proposed from live and historical KPI evidence, filtered by explicit SLA constraints and mined control rules, and committed only after post-action validation—enabling safe, adaptive QoS-aware network slicing in Open RAN.
